q1_execution_synchrony.mechanism: HTTP client awaits POST /agent/cycle; handler coordinates claim, orchestrator cycle execution, and returns AgentCycleResponse directly in HTTP response.

q2_cycle_granularity.mechanism: A single call to POST /agent/cycle drives exactly one supervisor integration and delegation phase, incrementing revision by at most 1.

q3_client_disconnect_behavior.mechanism: Cancellation during HTTP connection drop interrupts Python execution; SQLite atomic transactions ensure no half-committed working state or unlinked delegation records survive.

q5_concurrency_across_workers.boundary: BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction in SQLite guarantees mutual exclusion across multiple processes/workers; asyncio.Lock serializes requests within worker.

q6_revision_concurrency_check.mismatch_handling: Returns HTTP 409 Conflict with current authoritative revision when expected_working_state_revision != latest_working_state.revision.

q7_restart_recovery_behavior.action: recover_interrupted_agent_runtime marks claimed/running cycle executions as interrupted, marks active runs as failed(runtime_restart), pauses active investigations, and emits runtime_recovered trajectory event.

q8_task_deletion_safety.pre_execution_check: cpp_backend.get_task(task_id) before DB claim; returns 404 if deleted
q8_task_deletion_safety.post_execution_check: cpp_backend.get_task(task_id) before outcome commit; returns 404 and suppresses state persistence if task was deleted during cycle.

q9_grounding_and_hypothesis_boundary.grounding_validator: Strict handle resolution prevents raw keys, analyst notes, or ungrounded hypotheses from being accepted as evidence handles.

q10_finalization_and_report_isolation.finalization: Zero automatic finalization; gate remains closed unless explicitly triggered.
q10_finalization_and_report_isolation.report_admission: Zero report evidence admissions or analyst acceptances performed by agent cycle.
